text:
samir_support: Heads-up — Horizon Labs (acct HL-4421) just opened a ticket: invoice #INV-2026-09 for €18,450 failed 3x and auto-dunning triggered. Customer says card was declined in error and their bank marked it as "suspected fraud". Account was placed on hold at 09:22 UTC and they've lost API access. Ticket 84217.
anya: Can you paste the invoice + most recent payment gateway response? Need to confirm decline reasons before any hold removal.
samir_support: Invoice and gateway events below. Customer also uploaded a PO (PO-8877) but totals include VAT — the PO shows €18,450 net, billing shows €18,450 + 20% VAT = €22,140. They claim procurement expected VAT-exempt treatment.

-- invoice snippet --
Invoice: INV-2026-09
Amount: €22,140 (incl. 20% VAT)
Due date: 2026-09-05
Status: Past due / dunning level 2
PO on file: PO-8877 (amount field: 18450)

-- gateway log --
"{"event":"charge.failed","code":"card_declined","reason":"insufficient_funds","attempts":1}"

mike_finance: Gateway shows two different decline codes across attempts: first was `insufficient_funds`, second `do_not_honor`, third `fraud_suspected`. That aligns with customer's bank switching flags. We have three failed auth attempts at 09:10/09:14/09:18 UTC.
lisa_accts: Collections policy: after 3 failed attempts + 5 days past due we send dunning notice and auto-place hold. But for enterprise customers with PO, we can pause enforcement while finance verifies PO/VAT if we get confirmation within 48h. Did support attach the PO doc?
samir_support: Yea, PO attached in ticket: PO-8877 PDF. Procurement signed but value field doesn't include VAT. Customer claims they're VAT-registered in IE and should be reverse charge. They included VAT reg CN: IE1234567.
anya: If they have a valid VAT number we can reissue invoice without VAT and re-open access. We need verification: VAT registry check + updated invoice. I'll need someone in finance to confirm and reissue; collections should hold off reinstatement until payment or updated invoice issued. @mike_finance can you do VAT lookup and advise? :eyes:
mike_finance: On it. Quick check: VAT number format valid but need VIES lookup. If VIES confirms, we can credit the VAT portion (€3,690) and issue corrected invoice for €18,450; then remove hold pending payment of corrected invoice. Collections should retract dunning.
collections-bot: Automated notice: Dunning email #3 sent to billing@horizonlabs.com at 2026-09-10T09:20:12Z. Account flagged: HOLD.
samir_support: Customer is asking for immediate unfreeze so their infra isn't down — they say it's an internal bank hold and they can patch payment if we retry. They offered a new card. Support can collect card if finance authorizes a manual retry.
lisa_accts: Policy exception: we can perform a single manual authorization attempt after documentation verified. If the card succeeds, waive one late fee (<= €50) as goodwill, pending VAT correction. Need sign-off from revenue ops for fee waiver.
anya: I'll get revenue ops approval if finance confirms VAT eligibility. Samir — ask Horizon to add the new card via the self-serve link and mark in ticket to authorize immediate capture.
samir_support: Noted. I sent customer the link and explained steps. They've uploaded a screenshot from their bank showing the three declines flagged as "fraud prevention" on their side. They want dunning rescinded immediately; they're escalating to their legal if service remains down.
mike_finance: VIES returns valid VAT for IE1234567. I'll create credit note for €3,690 and reissue INV-2026-09-CORR for €18,450. Will block collections once credit note created. ETA 2 hours.

mike_finance: Attempting manual charge (card on file ending •••• 4242) now — performing auth.

POST /payments/auth
{ "account": "HL-4421", "method": "card_4242", "amount": 1845000, "currency": "EUR" }

mike_finance: Auth succeeded: `authorized` id auth_988122. Capture authorized for €18,450. I will hold capture until corrected invoice is issued to avoid overcharging.
lisa_accts: Ok finance confirms credit note + manual auth. I'll pause hold and retract outage notice to infra team. Samir — reinstate API keys immediately but keep rate limits locked until full resolution?
samir_support: Reinstated API access at 11:05 UTC. Notified customer. They confirmed new card succeeded; capture scheduled after correction. Customer requested written confirmation that late fees will be waived — I've asked revenue ops for confirmation.
anya: Great work. Follow-ups: (1) confirm capture after corrected invoice is issued, (2) send waiver confirmation, (3) update ticket 84217 with timeline and docs. Closing thread when capture completes. :white_check_mark:
